messages.subject: Pinnacle House - completion 29 September: statement and funds
messages.plaintextBody:
Fiona,

We're set to complete on Monday 29 September. Completion statement attached. The Tenant will pay on completion: rent deposit £183,750 plus VAT, apportioned insurance rent and on-account service charge - total set out in the statement. The first principal rent (£153,125, one quarter) falls on 29 June 2025 after the nine-month rent-free period. Board approved the grant on 26 September.

Elena
